verdict: Driver operation failed during Windows Update install. CBS could not read the driver identity or the driver payload was rejected by the servicing stack.
fix: Check `C:\Windows\Logs\CBS\CBS.log` for `Failed reading Identity for driver operation sequence` entries; the offending driver package ID is on that line. Remove that driver version, reboot, and let the update re-detect. If the failure is on an SSU (Servicing Stack Update), install the latest standalone SSU `.msu` manually before retrying the cumulative. SSU-cumulative combined packages must not be split.
